title: One enforced boundary for every privileged database client

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Every measurement below was taken on the implementation commit a35030eb, with the pre-fix comparison taken on a real detached worktree at a55de402. The merge SHA does not exist until the squash merge lands; post-merge-lane-close.yml rebinds it.

verifier.note: Bound after CI completes to the GitHub Actions run that produced the ci-db-proof-receipt/v2 and verified it in the required `verify` context. The implementing agent is not the verifier of the writable-DB claim by design.

test_totals.totals_note: `suites` counts the 96 `tsx --test` process runs that make up `pnpm test`; the per-process `# tests` lines sum to 3929 with zero failures, zero skips and zero cancellations.

verify.stop_reason: No staging credential exists on this workstation, so ci:assert-staging cannot resolve the approved staging project and refuses. That refusal is UTV2-1630's shipped control working as intended, not a gap here.
verify.authoritative_full_run: the required CI `verify` context on this head

runtime_proof.produced_by: ci.yml job staging-db-proof (the only job in that workflow holding a database credential)
runtime_proof.verified_by: scripts/ci/verify-db-proof-receipt.ts, executed inside the required `verify` context against its own GITHUB_* values
runtime_proof.note: Not asserted from proof text. Text cannot show which database a run targeted; a production run and an isolated run print identical TAP.

boundary_proof.method: AST construction-site inventory plus static import-graph reachability from the real `pnpm test` entrypoints; no string search, no credential, no connection

both_directions.note: Same guard, same inventory, two real trees. The pre-fix tree is a detached git worktree at a55de402, not a synthetic fixture, so the check is verified to fail the world it was written to describe.

negative_control.description: A two-line file constructing a client directly was added under scripts/, the guard run, the file removed, the guard run again.

residual_direct_sites: scripts/ops/db-health-tripwire.ts (postgres driver; connection string passed through assertPostgresConnectionAllowed)
scripts/shadow-scoring-runner.ts (deferred-cross-lane; owned by another open lane, not reachable from pnpm test)
enforcement_points: .github/workflows/ci.yml — step `Privileged DB client boundary` inside the required `verify` job
package.json — first stage of `verify:static`, so the local route cannot skip it either

known_limitations: scripts/shadow-scoring-runner.ts is not migrated: another open lane owns the file and has already changed it on its branch. Recorded in the inventory as deferred-cross-lane with that owner. It is not reachable from any pnpm test entrypoint, and the guard's reachability rule fails the build unconditionally the moment that stops being true.

Two Command Center browser components stay direct. They are anon-key only and the guard re-checks that premise every run, but nothing stops a new browser component being added under the same exemption through a reviewed inventory entry.

The boundary governs construction, not the environment. A process that is neither under node:test nor flagged staging-only may still reach production with a service-role key — that is production runtime and it must.

The inventory's `referenced` field, and therefore its `dead` bucket, is a heuristic over imports, npm scripts, workflows and doc mentions. Nothing enforces on it; all 45 dead entries were migrated regardless.

File scope lock is red on this PR and is not a required context: the guard reads file_scope_lock from the lane manifest as first committed on the branch, and this lane's manifest is created in a later commit than the implementation it covers.

Readiness Regression Gate and Live Schema Parity are red and pre-existing — a stale readiness score and 80 pre-existing migration/live-schema drift items respectively. Neither is a required context and this diff touches neither.
explicitly_not: no production credential in any checkout or PR-triggered workflow
no writable DB claim asserted from proof text
